description: Live EVM gas fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche: next base fee, slow/standard/fast tips (median of p10/p50/p90 over 20 blocks), EIP-1559 maxFee, and cost of a native or ERC-20 transfer in native and USD (Chainlink), incl. OP-stack L1 data fee. Optional gas=units. Picks cheapest chain. 502 if a chain is unreadable (not charged). PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/gas/estimate.

chains.description: comma list of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche (aliases eth, arb, op, matic, avax); default all

gas.description: optional gas units (21000-30000000) to price as a custom transaction

name: gas_estimate
title: Multi-chain EVM gas fees + USD transfer cost
